:::{#thm-conjunction-rule}
#### Conjunction

For [propositions](#def-proposition) $P$ and $Q$,
this is a [rule of inference](#def-rule-of-inference):

$$
\frac{P, \quad Q}{P \land Q}
$$

:::

::: proof

Suppose both [premises](#def-premise) are true.
By the definition of [and](#def-and),
$P \land Q$ is true
when $P$ and $Q$ are both true.
So the [conclusion](#def-conclusion) $P \land Q$ is true.

:::
